text: だっぴを　くりかえして　おおきくなる。

structure.jp: だっぴを　くりかえして
structure.en: by shedding its skin over and over

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here the first action is the way the second one comes about. くりかえして = 'by repeating it'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means 'become that way'. おおきくなる = 'get bigger'.
